checks.note: Deployed local-devnet bytecode hashes match compiled artifacts and the reviewed contract package.
Root registry, escrow, and bond vault reject zero or non-contract registry addresses at construction.
Identity registry bound the operator settlement key to the Chio Ed25519 key hash.
Entity binding authorization accepts a standards-compatible contract admin signature.
Inactive operator re-registration replaces reviewed key material and returns the record to active.
Identity registry admin handoff requires the nominated account to accept.
Entity bindings require current-admin authorization and can be deactivated or reassigned by the admin.
Expired delegates do not consume the active delegate cap.
Root registry accepted a bounded delegate publisher for the operator.
Unauthorized publishers revert fail closed.
Authorized delegate published a root against the operator namespace with canonical publisher traceability.
Root registry rejects proof metadata that does not match the published root geometry.
Revoked delegates can no longer publish roots.
Price resolver admin handoff requires the nominated account to accept.
Price resolver returned the configured feed value under healthy sequencer conditions.
Price resolver rejects invalid feeds, stale feeds, stale round metadata, zero or future sequencer timestamps, sequencer downtime, and sequencer grace-period reads.
Escrow and bond proof roots must be published under the operator key epoch they claim.
Escrow release rechecks operator activation before moving funds.
Bond release and impairment recheck operator activation before moving collateral.
Escrow custody accepts ERC20 transfers that succeed without return data.
Escrow custody rejects deposits whose received token balance is below the requested amount.
Bond vault custody rejects collateral whose received token balance is below the requested amount.
Escrow permit creation accepts an already-sufficient allowance if the permit call is unavailable.
Escrow accepts the detailed RFC6962 proof path and supports partial settlement.
Escrow accepts the operator-bound dual-signature release path and rejects mismatched signers.
Escrow refunds only after expiry and not before.
Expired escrow refund remains open while contract pause is active; pause gates create and release paths, not deadline recovery.
Escrow identity remains deterministic under interleaving submissions and duplicate replays fail closed.
Bond vault locks collateral on-chain while preserving reserve requirement metadata from the signed Chio bond terms for parity and review.
Bond vault releases collateral only on the detailed proof path and rejects the under-specified interface.
Bond impairment rejects token callbacks that reenter release.
Expired bond principal recovery remains open while contract pause is active; pause gates lock, release, and impair paths, not post-expiry principal exit.
Bond identity remains deterministic under interleaving submissions and duplicate replays fail closed.
Local-devnet gas estimates are within the deployment policy budgets.
